chapters.reason: The paper provides a theoretical characterization of problems solvable by filler tokens, relating them to the quantifier depth of first-order formulas and the computational power of transformers.
The paper explores how additional tokens (filler tokens) provide computational benefits, effectively acting as a mechanism to overcome depth-related bottlenecks in reasoning tasks.
The paper demonstrates that transformers can solve hard algorithmic tasks using filler tokens, showcasing the model's capability to perform multi-step computation without explicit chain-of-thought.
